candidates.change_summary: Change the function to return false immediately after successful calls, causing differing return value while keeping observable execution identical (no revert).
Change the function to return the negation of the original constant true by returning '!true' (i.e., false), altering observable return value while execution proceeds as before.

Return the success status of the last external call instead of always true, causing return value to differ when call returns false but no revert is triggered (kept require so only reachable when _s true; effect: returns last _s).

Change the call target selector to transferFrom(address,address,uint256) -> transferFrom(address,address,uint256) remains same but swapped argument order to call with (_tos[i], from, v) instead of (from, _tos[i], v), altering external contract effects and thus observable transfer outcomes.
Change the call selector to transfer(address,address,uint256) so external contract method invoked differs, changing observable transfer behavior.
Change loop to call only the first recipient rather than all, altering which transfers occur.
Remove the require on call success so failed external calls do not revert, changing final observable state after transfer.
